description: Compute pools end to end: the CREATE option set with MIN_NODES / MAX_NODES / INSTANCE_FAMILY required, SHOW COMPUTE POOLS' 21 columns and DESCRIBE's 23 (error_code and status_message added), declared column types via the CTAS+DESCRIBE proxy (counters NUMBER, flags VARCHAR, moments TIMESTAMP_LTZ, the family catalog's storage_gib VARCHAR despite its 93.13), optional-property defaults, every rejection's exact wording (duplicates, missing options, node ranges, family catalog, uppercase names, placement groups as a region registry, backup families, STOP ALL OF TYPE), ALTER SET/UNSET/SUSPEND/RESUME/STOP ALL, and SHOW's LIKE / STARTS WITH / LIMIT. Pools are ACCOUNT-level so each test drops the pools it creates. Converted from features/ComputePoolTest (tagsAreTheirOwnAlterActions stays in the trimmed Java class - the tag readback goes through the engine's catalog API). All tests skip the snowflake backend: pool creation is account-tier-gated (SPCS) and live listings carry SYSTEM_COMPUTE_POOL_* rows these exact-shape pins do not model.

SHOW COMPUTE POOLS
SET qid = LAST_QUERY_ID()
SELECT "name", "state", "min_nodes", "instance_family", "auto_suspend_secs", "auto_resume", "target_nodes", "comment", "is_exclusive" FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN($qid)) WHERE "name" = 'P1'

SELECT IFF("application" IS NULL, 'null', 'set'), IFF("placement_group" IS NULL, 'null', 'set'), '<' || "backup_instance_families" || '>', STARTSWITH(TO_VARCHAR("resumed_on"), '19') FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN($qid)) WHERE "name" = 'P1'
DROP COMPUTE POOL IF EXISTS P1
